| Country | Head of State (full name & official title) | Head of Government (full name & official title) |

### Notes on the leadership listings

* **United States** – The 2024 presidential election was won by the incumbent, President Joe Biden, who therefore began a second term on 20 January 2025. The U.S. Constitution makes the President both head of state and head of government.
